presets.name: REPEAT BASS
presets.desc: The dark disco staple: one note repeated in sixteenths, a saw over a sine sub in the ladder filter, the offbeat sixteenth pushed. Open the cutoff to make it bite.

presets.name: OFFBEAT REPEAT
presets.desc: Three sixteenths after every kick on one note, a hollow pulse wave through the Korg filter, short and dry, the first hit after the kick pushed.

presets.name: EIGHTH PULSE
presets.desc: A round new wave pulse: straight eighths on one note, a saw in a resonant 12 dB filter that thumps, a Juno chorus and a touch of warmth on top.

presets.name: LONG REPEAT
presets.desc: One note in sixteenths that never stops, long notes of a pulse and a square a few cents apart, the cutoff breathing slowly over eight bars: leave it running and ride the filter.

presets.name: GHOST REPEAT
presets.desc: One note with ghosts: a loud sixteenth, a soft one, a rest and a pickup, some soft ones left to chance, a hollow pulse in a resonant Korg filter that the accents open.

presets.name: OFFBEAT EIGHTHS
presets.desc: The disco offbeat: one note on every and, nothing on the kick, a narrow pulse over a deep sine sub in the ladder filter, a little overdrive for weight.

presets.name: CHUG BASS
presets.desc: A chugging single note: very short sixteenths, the Korg filter a little resonant and slapped by its envelope, the mixer and the overdrive pushed.

presets.name: THREE REPEAT
presets.desc: Two notes and a breath, three steps turning against the bar, the accent wandering across the beat: two saws a few cents apart in a resonant 12 dB filter, a Juno chorus.

presets.name: SWING REPEAT
presets.desc: A swung pluck on one note: three sixteenths and a breath on every beat, pushed late, a square with a saw an octave above snapping shut in the 12 dB filter, the cutoff swaying over two bars.

presets.name: FIFTH REPEAT
presets.desc: The root repeated three times and the fifth on the last sixteenth of every beat, a narrow pulse over a sine sub, a quiet dotted echo on the top.

presets.name: FALLING REPEAT
presets.desc: Eighths on the root for three beats, the fourth falling to the seventh below: a narrow pulse and a square swelling in softly through the 12 dB filter, warm and round.

presets.name: SUB HYPNO
presets.desc: Minimal and deep: a hollow wave between square and pulse over a big sine sub, three steps turning against the bar, the note and its octave.

presets.name: MUNICH GALLOP
presets.desc: The 1977 Munich gallop written into the notes: every eighth doubled a sixteenth later and softer, root, octave, fifth and seventh, a saw and a square plucked shut.

presets.name: MUNICH ECHO
presets.desc: Straight eighths and a real echo a sixteenth later that bounces left and right: the gallop comes from the delay. Turn DELAY up for the full effect, down for plain eighths.

presets.name: GALLOP BASS
presets.desc: The disco gallop on one note: one, and, a, the rest between, a saw thumping in a resonant ladder filter with a little warmth, an octave pair closing the bar, a quiet dotted echo.

presets.name: HI-NRG OCTAVES
presets.desc: High energy octaves: root and octave in sixteenths without a gap, a short square in the ladder filter, F sharp minor then A.

presets.name: ROLLING TRIPLETS
presets.desc: Eighths with the offbeat split in three: a rolling gallop on one note, a saw over a sine sub in a resonant ladder filter, a Juno chorus, the octave in the last roll.

presets.name: DISCO OCTAVES
presets.desc: Disco octaves in eighths through F sharp minor, D and E: a square and a saw, a short slide up into the octave closing every second bar.

presets.name: SPACE DISCO
presets.desc: Space disco: a saw and a triangle bouncing root and octave, a Juno chorus and a quiet dotted echo making it float above the kick.

presets.name: STRUT BASS
presets.desc: A slow disco strut: syncopated root and octave with a glide into the last notes, a round saw in the ladder filter, room between the notes.

presets.name: ITALO OCTAVES
presets.desc: The italo octave bass: root, root, octave, root in sixteenths, a saw with a Juno chorus, through F sharp minor, D, E and back.

presets.name: ITALO DOTTED
presets.desc: Dotted eighths in the italo way, three three two: a pulse wave jumping to the octave, F sharp minor to D, a small chorus.

presets.name: ITALO RUNNER
presets.desc: A running italo line: octave pairs in sixteenths, root root octave octave, a square and a pulse in the 12 dB filter with a Juno chorus.

presets.name: COSMIC BASS
presets.desc: Cosmic disco eighths that glide: root and octave with a slow portamento, a soft saw in the 12 dB filter, chorus and warmth.

presets.name: MIDNIGHT BASS
presets.desc: Late night italo: sparse sixteenths around the root, the octave and the fifth, a square and a saw with a Juno chorus, a dark dotted tape echo behind.

presets.name: BOWED FIFTHS
presets.desc: Root, fifth, octave, fifth in eighths with soft bowed attacks, a saw in the ladder filter swaying over four bars, slightly swung, F sharp minor to B minor.

presets.name: RUBBER BASS
presets.desc: A rubber bass that bounces and slides into its octaves, syncopated against the kick, a saw and a square in the 12 dB filter with a Juno chorus.

presets.name: BOUNCE BASS
presets.desc: Body music bounce: short hard notes jumping between root and octave, a square snapping in a resonant 12 dB filter, three on the beat and one off it.

presets.name: BODY BOUNCE
presets.desc: Italo melody on an EBM body: sixteenths after the kick hopping root and octave, a saw and a square in the ladder filter, a little overdrive, a short echo bouncing on the top.

presets.name: ELASTIC BASS
presets.desc: Elastic eighths: every note glides into the next, root, octave, fifth, octave, a soft square over a sine sub in the ladder filter.

presets.name: SLIDE OCTAVE
presets.desc: Dotted notes that slide up to the octave and back, three three two, a wave between saw and square in a resonant 12 dB filter, long and rubbery, a little warmth.

presets.name: PWM BOUNCE
presets.desc: A pulse wave whose width breathes over one bar, bouncing root and octave around the kick, the ladder filter half open.

presets.name: EBM SIXTEENTHS
presets.desc: Body music sixteenths between the kicks: a saw and a square through the Korg filter, short and hard, the first after the kick slapped.

presets.name: BODY BASS
presets.desc: Straight eighths that never stop, a square and a saw short and hard in the Korg filter, an octave jump closing every bar, bus glue.

presets.name: STEEL BASS
presets.desc: An early eighties body sequence: root, root, minor third, root, the fifth answering, a square wave in a brighter 12 dB filter.

presets.name: COLD BASS
presets.desc: Cold wave: the bass played high like a lead, the octave above walking down the scale in eighths, a hollow square through the Korg filter with a Juno chorus and a short echo.

presets.name: KNOCK BASS
presets.desc: A wooden knock: a sine touched by FM with a triangle an octave above, very short, a broken figure around the kick for minimal grooves.

presets.name: SYNC BASS
presets.desc: A hard sync bass in sixteenth pairs around the kick: the second saw locked to the first a fifth up and swept over four bars, held dark by the ladder filter.

presets.name: WALKING DISCO
presets.desc: A walking disco line: root and octave with a pickup, then up through the fifth and the sixth to the seventh, over F sharp minor, A, B minor and D, a round square with a Juno chorus, glue and warmth.

presets.name: NEW BEAT BASS
presets.desc: Slow Belgian body music: rubbery offbeat eighths with a slide down to the fifth, a saw and a deep sub, the ladder filter a little resonant.

presets.name: SLOW RUBBER
presets.desc: At 105: long notes that slide between the root and the fifth below, a square over a sine sub, the filter opening slowly on each note.

presets.name: ACID NEW BEAT
presets.desc: Acid at new beat speed, an octave down on the low F sharp: a saw and a square, the resonance up, accents and slides into the octave, a dub tape echo behind.

presets.name: HYPNO SEQ
presets.desc: Berlin school against the four on the floor: three notes turning over sixteen, a saw over a square an octave below, the cutoff drifting over four bars.

presets.name: REPEAT SEQ
presets.desc: The repeated note in the middle register: a pluck of two saws in sixteenths, the cutoff moving over two bars, a Juno chorus. Put it over a bass on the same note.

presets.name: OCTAVE SEQ
presets.desc: Octave sixteenths in the middle, a pulse wave plucked by the Korg filter, a dotted eighth echo low in the mix to blur the edges.

presets.name: ITALO ARP
presets.desc: An italo arpeggio climbing sevenths over two octaves in sixteenths, a pulse and a saw with a Juno chorus, through F sharp minor, D, E and C sharp minor.

presets.name: DARK ARP
presets.desc: A dark three note arpeggio falling against the bar, a pulse wave in the Korg filter, its width jumping at random, F sharp minor to C sharp minor.

presets.name: PLUCK SEQ
presets.desc: A swung pluck: two saws a few cents apart snapping shut in the 12 dB filter, chord tones on the offbeats, a dotted echo answering them.

presets.name: BLEEP SEQ
presets.desc: Clean bleeps: sine and triangle tones, short and dry, a sparse two octave figure that leaves room for the drums, one quiet echo a quarter late.

presets.name: ECHO SEQ
presets.desc: Four notes a bar and a dotted tape echo that writes the rest of the pattern: a saw and a triangle, soft and round. Change the delay time and the rhythm changes.

presets.name: TRIPLET SEQ
presets.desc: Every eighth note played three times as fast triplets: root, octave, fifth, octave, a short square through the Korg filter with a Juno chorus, rolling across the beat.

presets.name: POLY SEQ
presets.desc: Five steps against sixteen, three notes and two rests: a saw and a hollow square, the pattern landing somewhere new on every bar.

presets.name: RATCHET SEQ
presets.desc: A sparse figure that stutters: a pulse wave plucked by the ladder filter, double, triple and quadruple hits inside single steps.

presets.name: SYNC SEQ
presets.desc: A hard sync figure that cuts without getting bright: the second saw locked to the first, its pitch swept over two bars, short syncopated notes.

presets.name: WOOD SEQ
presets.desc: Percussive wood for minimal grooves: a sine knocked by FM, very short, a broken figure with notes left to chance.

presets.name: GLASS SEQ
presets.desc: Glassy plinks: a sine and a triangle an octave apart, a slow figure in eighths, a dotted quarter echo and a short dark room behind.

presets.name: ACID SEQ
presets.desc: An acid line in the middle register: one saw, the resonance singing, accents and slides into the octave, to sit over a plain bass.

presets.name: DOTTED SEQ
presets.desc: Dotted eighths written into the notes: a saw and a triangle every three sixteenths, nine steps turning against the bar.

presets.name: MINOR ARP
presets.desc: Minor ninths broken up and down in swung sixteenths, a square and a triangle with the wide Juno chorus and a quiet dotted quarter echo, F sharp minor seven to B minor.

presets.name: CASCADE SEQ
presets.desc: A slow cascade falling from the octave to the root in sixteenths, a square and a triangle, a soft decay, a quarter note tape echo stretching it.

presets.name: PULSE SEQ
presets.desc: A pulse wave repeating one note in sixteenths, its width swept over two bars by the LFO, the 12 dB filter half open.

presets.name: DRIFT SEQ
presets.desc: A drifting slow sequence in eighths, the oscillators wandering, a cassette like tape echo, root fifth and seventh.

presets.name: DARK LEAD
presets.desc: A dark mono lead: a saw and a square gliding between long notes, a Juno chorus and a dotted quarter echo, low enough to sit under a vocal.

presets.name: SYNC LEAD
presets.desc: A mono sync lead with bite but no glare: the second saw locked and tuned up a fifth, a slow sweep of its pitch, a short riff on the octave.

presets.name: ITALO LEAD
presets.desc: An italo hook: a pulse wave with the wide Juno chorus and a dotted echo, a falling eight note melody over F sharp minor and D.

presets.name: BRASS STAB
presets.desc: A synth brass stab: two saws a few cents apart with a quick filter swell, on the and of two and a double hit before four, F sharp minor to A.

presets.name: MINOR STAB
presets.desc: A minor stab: a saw on the root and a square on the minor third above, snapping shut, syncopated sixteenths over F sharp minor and B minor.

presets.name: ORGAN STAB
presets.desc: A house organ: two squares an octave apart over a square sub, a fast organ envelope, a stab on the and of every beat with little pickups.

presets.name: FIFTH STAB
presets.desc: Two saws a fifth apart, stacked and spread, a soft decaying stab on every offbeat, a dotted eighth echo low behind it.

presets.name: SEVENTH STAB
presets.desc: A deep minor seventh stab: a soft wave and a saw a seventh apart in a round 12 dB filter, two long chords a bar, F sharp minor to B minor.

presets.name: HOOK LEAD
presets.desc: A simple two bar hook to build on: a soft saw and a triangle, the minor third and the fifth answering the root, a quiet dotted echo.

presets.name: WHISTLE LEAD
presets.desc: A whistling triangle lead with a slight vibrato, long notes on the fifth and the octave, a short dark room around it.

presets.name: STRING PAD
presets.desc: A string machine: two saws an octave apart with the wide Juno chorus, slow attacks, triads rising in quarter notes, F sharp minor to D.

presets.name: DARK PAD
presets.desc: A dark low pad: stacked saws in a closed ladder filter, sevenths melting in quarter notes, the cutoff moving slowly over four bars.

presets.name: PULSE PAD
presets.desc: A pad that pulses: ninths arpeggiated up and down in sixteenths, two saws stacked and spread, soft attacks and tails that overlap.

presets.name: BREAK PAD
presets.desc: For the breakdown: slow quarter notes of a seventh chord melting together, stacked saws spread wide, a short dark room.

presets.name: FIFTH DRONE
presets.desc: A drone for the break: a low fifth held without a gap, the mixer pushed into the ladder filter, the level pulsing in eighths and the cutoff moving over four bars.

presets.name: CHOIR PAD
presets.desc: A soft choir: triangles stacked and spread, sevenths rising and falling in slow quarter notes, the cutoff breathing over four bars, a short room.

presets.name: TAPE PAD
presets.desc: A worn pad: two saws and a square in eighths of a slow arpeggio, a wobbling tape echo, warmth on the master, a little drift.

presets.name: NIGHT DRONE
presets.desc: A dark drone with the root and the octave held, a hollow square and a saw, the cutoff and the resonance drifting over eight bars, a quiet echo.
